e52c25f254700714.title: Combinatorics Seminar: Hyperplane arrangements and shuffling cards
e52c25f254700714.desc: Jason Fulman, USC Title: Hyperplane arrangements and shuffling cards Abstract: Bidigare, Hanlon, and Rockmore discovered a combinatorial notion of random walk on the chambers of a real hyperplane arrangement. Their construction includes shuffling methods such as the top to random shuffle and ordinary riffle shuffling. They obtain a combinatorial formula for the eigenvalues of the transition matrix of these Markov chains, which turn out to have all eigenvalues real despite being non-symmetric. There are also a number of extensions (random walk on oriented matroids, buildings, and left-regular bands).

e55b2685e70b7ca6.title: SiM
e55b2685e70b7ca6.desc: SiM exploded out of Japan and on to the international scene at the beginning of 2022 when their song “THE RUMBLING” was featured as the theme song for acclaimed anime ATTACK ON TITAN. Since its release, the song has been streamed more than 300 million times and was the #1 metal song on Spotify for 2022, spending seven straight weeks on the Billboard Hot Hard Rock songs, peaking at #1. Formed in Shonan, Kanagawa, Japan in 2004, SiM has released five full length albums and numerous singles and EPs featuring their unique blend of ska, punk, reggae, and metal. SiM are known for filling arenas and major festivals throughout Japan with their incredible live shows including their own annual weekend festival, DEAD POP FESTIVAL in Kawasaki City, Japan.
